uncited: Gaussian Voxelization converts continuous 3D Gaussian primitives into a discrete, structured voxel representation to enable efficient processing by downstream networks and rendering pipelines.
It encompasses methods that initialize Gaussians from point clouds, aggregate splat attributes onto grid cells, generate navigable sparse octrees, and export to USD formats.
Variants differ in their focus on geometric initialization, feature embedding for neural processing, or physics-compatible mesh generation.
